blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Employer branding is the image of the company as a workplace. When people say "That is a great place to work", that is employer branding.

It is how the company looks to candidates and to the market. A company can be friendly, fair, and modern. These words describe a good workplace.

A strong employer brand helps to attract good people. Good people want to work in companies that are friendly, fair, and modern. A good reputation starts with happy people.

items.q: What is employer branding?
options: The image of the company as a workplace
items.why: "Employer branding is the image of the company as a workplace."

items.q: A strong employer brand helps to…
items.why: "A strong employer brand helps to attract good people."

items.q: Which words describe a good workplace in the text?
items.why: "companies that are friendly, fair, and modern."

items.q: The text suggests that a good reputation comes from…
items.why: Inferência: "A good reputation starts with happy people" — pessoas felizes criam a boa fama.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: only money makes a good workplace
a friendly company attracts good candidates
the company image is not important
candidates do not look at the company
items.why: Inferência: o texto liga marca forte e ambiente amigável à atração de boas pessoas.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily preparando os posts para as redes sociais. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I am Emily. Today I am writing some posts for our social media. I want to show why Czarnikow is a great place to work.

First, I will write about our people. Our team is friendly and our team is diverse. People here help each other every day. That is very important for me.

Next, I want to talk about our values. Our values are clear and honest. We are fair with everyone. I think this is a strong message for new candidates.

I also want to add one photo of the office. It is modern and open. People can see that it is a nice place. A modern office gives a good image.

My goal is simple. I want good people to see our posts and think: "I want to work there!" A strong employer brand starts with happy people, and our people are happy. So I am proud to share this with the market.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Emily writing today?
items.why: "Today I am writing some posts for our social media."

items.q: How does Emily describe the team?
items.why: "Our team is friendly and our team is diverse."

items.q: What does Emily say about the office?
items.why: "It is modern and open… A modern office gives a good image."

items.q: Why does Emily want to talk about values? (inference)
options: because it is a strong message for new candidates
because the boss told her to
items.why: Inferência: ela diz que valores claros e honestos são "a strong message for new candidates".

items.q: How does Emily feel about her company? (inference)
options: She is worried about the team.
She does not like the office.
She is proud and happy to share it.
She is bored with the job.
items.why: Inferência: "I am proud to share this" e "our people are happy" mostram orgulho.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our office is modern and bright." Modern means…
items.why: Modern = moderno, novo e atual.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A good company is ___ with all workers, not only with the managers."
items.why: Fair = justo: trata todos de forma igual.

items.q: "Czarnikow has a good reputation in the market." Reputation means…
options: how people see and talk about the company
items.why: Reputation = reputação: a fama, como as pessoas veem a empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A strong brand helps to ___ good candidates to the company."
items.why: To attract = atrair: trazer boas pessoas para a empresa.

items.q: "Our values are clear and honest." Values are…
options: the ideas and beliefs the company follows
items.why: Values = valores: as ideias e princípios que a empresa segue.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the new post." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o "ok".

items.q: "We will roll out the new posts next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, colocar no ar aos poucos.

items.q: "Emily wants to show off the friendly team." To show off means to…
items.why: Show off = exibir com orgulho.

items.q: "Good branding can help the company stand out in the market." To stand out means to…
options: be easy to notice and different
items.why: Stand out = destacar-se, chamar a atenção.

items.q: "Let's follow up after the posts go live." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, verificar depois.
